annotations.title: Check if a site is a gambling site

description: Checks web addresses against the Silex blocklist of about 294,000 gambling, betting and casino domains (the list Silex's iPhone app and free browser extension block). Sub-domains match their parent. Use when someone asks whether a site is a gambling or betting site, or whether a blocker would stop it.
name: check_gambling_site
title: Check if a site is a gambling site
